quiz_title: Web Design Advanced - Quiz 6: DOM Manipulation & BOM

questions.q: Which DOM selector accesses tags using CSS styles (like dots for classes)?
questions.exp: querySelector('selector') selects the first matching tag using CSS class or ID styles!

questions.q: Which event triggers when a student clicks on a button?
questions.exp: onclick registers user mouse clicks, instantly triggering assigned script actions!

questions.q: Which window property gets the viewport width of browser screens?
questions.exp: window.innerWidth returns live widths of browser viewports, which is essential for BOM sizing!

questions.q: How do you save persistent local data that survives browser page refreshes?
questions.exp: localStorage.setItem() saves key-value string files persistently inside the user's browser!

questions.q: What is the difference between ES6 'let' and 'const' variables?
opts: Let can be reassigned, Const cannot
Const can be reassigned, Let cannot
Let is global, Const is block
questions.exp: let declares variables that can change values, while const declares final fixed constants!
